pois.name: Tour Saint-Jacques
pois.description: Gothic flamboyant tower, 52m, sole remnant of the 16th-century church of Saint-Jacques-de-la-Boucherie. The highest point in the district.

pois.name: Centre Pompidou
pois.description: Renzo Piano and Richard Rogers' radical 1977 inside-out cultural centre. 100,000 works in the national modern art collection.

pois.name: Place des Vosges
pois.description: Paris's oldest planned square (1612). 36 identical brick-and-stone pavilions under vaulted arcades. Victor Hugo lived at no. 6.

pois.name: Musée Picasso
pois.description: 5,000 works across the 17th-century Hôtel Salé — the world's largest Picasso collection.

pois.name: Musée Carnavalet
pois.description: The history of Paris told through 625,000 objects across two Renaissance mansions. Free entry.

pois.name: Marché des Enfants Rouges
pois.description: Paris's oldest covered market (1615). A maze of stalls serving Moroccan tajines, Japanese bentos, Italian antipasti and crêpes.
